anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals (1, 5, and 15 minutes), indicating potential performance bottlenecks.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows zero total profit/loss and zero win rate despite having closed trades, which may indicate an issue with trade execution or reporting.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review AI system configuration and logs to ensure it is correctly set up to generate learning cycles and opportunities.
Analyze trading strategy performance and execution to ensure trades are being processed correctly and profit/loss is accurately reported.

recommendations.action: Conduct a detailed analysis of CPU usage to identify and address any processes that are causing high load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system slowdowns and affect the performance of trading operations.

recommendations.action: Check the AI system's configuration and logs to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
